simple.meaning: הָרָה (hârâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to be (or become ) pregnant , conceive (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 43 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Judges, 1 Samuel, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 4:1. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הָרָה (H2029).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: הָרָה (hârâh) / H2029 is traced through Genesis 4:1, Genesis 4:17, Genesis 16:4, Genesis 16:5 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H2029. harah I. הָרָה verb conceive, become pregnant (Assyrian êrû compare Dl Pr 21 Muss.-Arnolt Hebraica.
